questions.question:
Select the correct passive voice of the given sentence.

She is making a beautiful beaded curtain.
options: A beautiful beaded curtain was being made by her.
A beautiful beaded curtain is being made by her.
A beautiful beaded curtain is made by her.
A beautiful beaded curtain was made by her.
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is 'A beautiful beaded curtain is being made by her.' Key Points The given sentence is in the  Active Voice.  As per the given question we have to change the sentence into  Passive Form.  The given sentence is an example of  'present continuous'.   The structure of these kinds of sentences is: Subject + is/am/are + V 1  + ing + Object. (Active Voice) Subject(Objective Case) + is/am/are + being+ V 3  + by +

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

They catch whale sharks commercially in some places around the world.
options: Whale sharks are caught commercially in some places around the world.
Whale sharks are being caught commercially in some places around the world.
Whale sharks were caught commercially in some places around the world.
Whale sharks have been caught commercially in some places around the world.
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is ' Whale sharks are caught commercially in some places around the world '. Key Points The given sentence is in  Active Voice.  As per the question we have to change it into  Passive Voice.  The structure of the given sentence is as follows: Subject + V 1  + Object. (Active Voice) Subject (Objective Case) + is/am/are + V 3  + Object (Subjective Case). (Passive Voice)  Example: Aastha teaches English. (Active Voice)&nbs

Jayesh said to Diwakar, "You can top the class if you want to."
